final_message: Parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading each entry, filtering for ERROR and CRITICAL levels, converting timestamps to UTC, extracting the message, exception, and repeat count, and aggregating counts by service. Then wrote the structured data to workspace/errors.json following the specified format and Acme log-triage conventions. The output file contains the filtered error entries and counts by service.
